title.zh: OpenAI Jalapeño（首款自研推理芯片）

evidence.quote: OpenAI 與 Broadcom（NASDAQ: AVGO）今日發佈 Jalapeño，這是 OpenAI 首款 Intelligence Processor（智能處理器）：一款按 OpenAI 對 LLM 推理未來願景而設計的加速器。
Jalapeño 晶片的工程樣本已在實驗室以量產目標頻率與功耗運行機器學習（ML）工作負載，包括 GPT‑5.3‑Codex‑Spark。
Jalapeño 從初步設計到製造流片僅用九個月便共同開發完成
該平台計劃於 2026 年底前初步部署，並在其後數年擴展

notes.zh:
回答「OpenAI 有没有自研芯片、现在到哪一步」。Jalapeño 是 OpenAI 首款 Intelligence Processor，专为 LLM 推理设计，由 OpenAI 设计、Broadcom 做硅实现与网络、Celestica 做板卡/机架；工程样片已在实验室以量产目标频率与功耗跑 GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark，设计到流片 9 个月，计划 2026 年底初步部署，后续扩到吉瓦级。
不主张：官方没有公开 HBM 容量、算力、功耗、制程与单价；「每瓦性能大幅超越现有最先进水平」是 OpenAI 基于早期测试的口径，详细技术报告尚未发布；2026 年底是初步部署计划，不是已量产；Jalapeño 不对外销售或出租，先服务 OpenAI 自家模型与产品。
notes.en:
Answers whether OpenAI has its own silicon and how far it has gone. Jalapeño is OpenAI's first Intelligence Processor, designed for LLM inference: OpenAI designs it, Broadcom handles silicon implementation and networking, and Celestica builds boards and racks. Engineering samples already run GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark in the lab at production target frequency and power; design-to-tape-out took nine months; initial deployment is planned for the end of 2026, expanding over following years.
It does not claim: OpenAI has not published HBM capacity, compute, power, process node or unit price; "substantially better performance per watt than today's state of the art" is OpenAI's early-test claim and the detailed technical report is still to come; end-2026 is an initial deployment plan, not volume production; Jalapeño is not sold or rented externally and first serves OpenAI's own models and products.

specs.进度 / progress: 工程样片以量产目标频率/功耗运行 GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
specs.部署 / deployment: 2026 年底初步部署，后续扩至吉瓦级
specs.公开规格 / public specs: 官方未披露 HBM / 算力 / 功耗 / 制程
